verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is built into Stripe's own payments flow: Payment Links collect tax with no code, and tax collection is tied to processing payments. That gives native, no-plumbing transaction feed-in only within Stripe's own stack. Payments processed outside Stripe require the developer to call the standalone Tax Calculations/Transactions APIs, which are building blocks rather than maintained connectors. The TaxJar integration covers filing, not transaction ingestion. Missing for 10: documented maintained connectors for third-party billing systems, other payment processors, and commerce platforms; independent corroboration of integration breadth.

support.subject: As a developer, there are maintained integrations for my revenue stack — billing systems, payment processors, and commerce platforms feed transactions in without me building the plumbing

citations.quote: Collect tax on Payment Links: Learn how to calculate and collect tax on a payment page without writing any code.
Register to collect tax as soon as you start processing payments.
